findings.title: Missing HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security)
findings.details: The HTTP response does not include the standard 'Strict-Transport-Security' header.
findings.remediation: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload' in web server config.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
findings.details: The HTTP response does not include the standard 'Content-Security-Policy' header.
findings.remediation: Define a robust CSP header to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and unauthorized data injection.

findings.title: Missing Clickjacking Defense (X-Frame-Options)
findings.details: The HTTP response does not include the standard 'X-Frame-Options' header.
findings.remediation: Set 'X-Frame-Options: DENY' or 'SAMEORIGIN' to block framing/clickjacking attacks.

findings.title: Missing MIME-Sniffing Protection (X-Content-Type-Options)
findings.details: The HTTP response does not include the standard 'X-Content-Type-Options' header.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.details: The HTTP response does not include the standard 'Referrer-Policy' header.
findings.remediation: Set 'Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin' to prevent URL data leaks.

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy (Feature-Policy)
findings.details: The HTTP response does not include the standard 'Permissions-Policy' header.
findings.remediation: Restrict browser features like camera, microphone, and geolocation via Permissions-Policy header.
